title.narrative: Delegation Agreement between the EU and the EIF in respect of the Administration of a Participation in the European Fund for South East Europe (EFSE)

description.narrative: This Action aims at securing continuation of the EU investments in the financial instrument European Fund for South East Europe (EFSE). The overall objective is to foster economic development and prosperity in South East Europe through the provision of development financing for micro-finance projects.
